meaning: MAPPED describes core backend contract coverage, not completed React Native screens or production readiness. SH09 retains its POLICY_DEFERRED help/contact boundary.

screens.title: Admin home
screens.notes: Compose cards by the selected preset; Accounts cannot request academic dashboard records. Use finance overview for Accounts.

screens.title: Student list
screens.notes: Use search/class filters and cursor pagination. Shared export downloads are direct responses.

screens.title: Register or edit a student
screens.notes: Enrol once, then use the saved event for provisioning status/retry. A reviewed replacement can correct only an unapplied staff/guardian account match; pupil identity and enrolment stay stable. Attach documents to the accepted pupil ID. Invitations are pending-account access, never an active global password reset.

screens.title: Student profile
screens.notes: School Office uses /invoices/fee-status for a selected pupil and optional term. It receives read-only balances/status, not invoice lines, payer details or payment evidence. Principal/Accounts retain full invoice permissions.

screens.title: Parents and guardians list
screens.notes: Search by guardian name/phone or child name/admission number. Existing global-account linking needs the exact supplied login and school verification; no global account search is exposed.

screens.title: Guardian profile and child links
screens.notes: Read invitation/account state before issuing private activation instructions. Replacement/revocation invalidates reviewed activation flows too. Accepted global accounts keep their private recovery proofs. A failed unapplied guardian account match has a reviewed replacement action; child-link revocation remains separate.

screens.title: Register or edit a teacher
screens.notes: Registration returns the saved provisioning event; status/retry and reviewed unapplied-account repair retain the staff ID. Office manages teacher records; Principal manages administrator access. Credentials have private document purpose and explicit self visibility.

screens.title: Teacher profile and responsibilities
screens.notes: Handover teaching/attendance duties before removing teacher access. Teacher timetable reads can be filtered locally by selected teacher from authorised office data.

screens.title: School settings and admin access
screens.notes: Principal manages administrator provisioning/invitations and versioned settlement settings; Accounts reads payment settings/history. Pausing checkout preserves existing verification. A settings/subaccount format check is not bank-ownership verification. Secrets remain backend configuration.

screens.title: School calendar and daily times
screens.notes: Existing unused term/session dates use reviewed versions and reasons. Terms with dated school work keep their boundaries; published calendar revisions handle exceptions. Principal selects activeSessionId using the school-settings version; it is a display default and cannot override dated placement or permissions.

screens.title: Classes, subjects and departments
screens.notes: Subjects support versioned rename/deactivation while immutable codes and historical reports remain stable. Current/future assignment/curriculum use blocks retirement. Rooms have stable uppercase codes, display names, capacity, active state and versions. New uses reject inactive resources; legacy room labels retain their spelling with canonical conflict matching.

screens.title: One class and its student list
screens.notes: Parents/students receive only their own eligible pupil row; teacher and office rosters are scoped. Do not treat a family roster as the whole class.

screens.title: Build the weekly timetable
screens.notes: Choose an active room catalogue code. Legacy text saves create a matching catalogue record. Canonical room conflicts and review checks prevent case variants or cloned inactive rooms from bypassing scheduling rules. Eligibility remains separate from actual teaching assignments.

screens.title: Review and publish the timetable
screens.notes: Publish only after review passes. Use schedule/day for dated exam replacements; use timetable for the weekly pattern.

screens.title: Attendance and absence follow-up
screens.notes: Submitted-only attendance, teacher requests, stale-source office decisions, reviewed family alerts and private follow-up notes have explicit workflows. Staff use child/category/resource delivery filters and a separate delivery-command version. Retry rechecks current recipient/device/preferences and cannot replay confirmed, expired, invalid-device or pending-receipt sends.

screens.title: View or correct a class register
screens.notes: Submitted-only attendance, teacher requests, stale-source office decisions, reviewed family alerts and private follow-up notes have explicit workflows. Staff use child/category/resource delivery filters and a separate delivery-command version. Retry rechecks current recipient/device/preferences and cannot replay confirmed, expired, invalid-device or pending-receipt sends.

screens.title: Set exams and grading rules
screens.notes: The adopted 20/20/60, one-decimal, A-F and no-rank policy is read-only and frozen per cycle. Principal explicitly approves it in DRAFT or records approval when opening marks. A configurable rule builder is outside the adopted presentation-school policy; no setting can rewrite accepted reports.

screens.title: Review and publish results
screens.notes: Subject sheets → class-lead remarks/ratings → submit-review → principal publish. Late placement changes require roster/sync, and published cycles must be reopened first.

screens.title: Reports
screens.notes: Select permitted academic, finance or complaint catalogues by staff preset. JSON previews return READY synchronously; the same report request with format=PDF or CSV produces a protected download. Specific filters, current role/class-lead/subject scope, accepted report snapshots and 1,000-row bounds are enforced. Refresh regenerates the view; arbitrary queries/background export jobs are outside these supported report types.

screens.title: Set fees and issue bills
screens.notes: Edit only a fee-plan draft, publish it, preview a batch and confirm the reviewed roster hash.

screens.title: Student invoices
screens.notes: Use current invoice balances; never recompute the official balance from original total minus gross payments alone.

screens.title: Invoice detail and office payment
screens.notes: Accounts records payments; a different principal approves the requesting principal’s financial adjustment. Money is integer NGN kobo.

screens.title: Payments and money checks
screens.notes: Confirmed payments, checkout attempts and bank/provider settlement remain separate. Accounts/Principal can inspect attempt history, fee delivery states and bounded finance reports. Safe delivery metadata excludes payer contact/proofs and message content; retry does not turn queued mail into a confirmed delivery.

screens.title: Payment detail and refund review
screens.notes: Prepare/request and independently approve refunds, execute through the bank/provider, then confirm with evidence/authoritative provider outcome. This is the agreed external-disbursement workflow; this API does not automatically send refund money. Refund report states distinguish request/approval from confirmed return.

screens.title: Preview promotion or completion
screens.notes: Preview only from the published source evidence. JSS3 needs an explicit SSS1 pathway; missing evidence stays REVIEW.

screens.title: Approve promotion and graduation
screens.notes: The source academic year must have ended. Confirmation rejects changed source results and cannot duplicate a prior source-year outcome.

screens.title: School announcements
screens.notes: Principal/Office can inspect a published notice recipient/read summary and per-notification channel states. Manual retry targets a failed delivery with reason/version and preserves current access/preferences, leases and expiry. Provider receipt and in-app reading remain different evidence.

screens.title: School messages
screens.notes: Contacts and permitted thread participants come from the server; no arbitrary account-ID recipient picker.

screens.title: One private conversation
screens.notes: Private child-linked threads; current participants only. File reads require their owning thread/case/assignment permissions.

screens.title: Complaints list
screens.notes: Walk-in/phone intake belongs to office staff. Staff-conduct complaints are restricted to Principal.

screens.title: Complaint details and resolution
screens.notes: Case ownership/category and private-note rules apply. Staff can inspect permitted case delivery metadata; only the current owner or Principal retries a case delivery. Complaint register/backlog exports retain preset limits and omit message bodies/private notes.

screens.title: Bring in or download school data
screens.notes: Verified historical document copies use /documents and do not generate official marks. Only published permitted copies are returned. CSV imports use their specific preview/job/confirm routes.

screens.title: School change history
screens.notes: Request the permitted service domain separately: academics, finance, identity or communication. Do not join databases in the app.

screens.title: Teacher home
screens.notes: The Presenter composes this home from existing scoped APIs; there is no separate teacher-dashboard endpoint.

screens.title: My classes and subjects
screens.notes: Eligibility does not assign work. teaching-assignments returns actual current assignments; my-classes identifies class-lead duty.

screens.title: Class workspace
screens.notes: Class/subject material reads are scoped. Families see the accepted snapshot while the teacher edits the next draft; attachments require the same audience.

screens.title: Student learning profile
screens.notes: Learning profile access follows a current dated class assignment. Complete class reports are restricted to the class lead, not every subject teacher.

screens.title: Timetable and calendar
screens.notes: Daily view shows teaching/invigilation and supervised activities. Examinations lists relevant published exam schedules.

screens.title: Attendance centre
screens.notes: The assigned class teacher submits registers and requests later corrections. Pending requests do not change accepted attendance; the office approves or declines after review.

screens.title: Daily class register
screens.notes: The assigned class teacher submits registers and requests later corrections. Pending requests do not change accepted attendance; the office approves or declines after review.

screens.title: Create or edit assignment
screens.notes: Use only actual assigned class/subject IDs. File upload and publish are separate accepted actions.

screens.title: Assignment and submissions
screens.notes: Choose APP or PHYSICAL when creating the assignment. Only the assigned teacher records physical receipt with its school date, reason and optional private evidence.

screens.title: Review student submission
screens.notes: Review drafts are teacher-only. Release checks the accepted submission version; parents and students see only released feedback.

screens.title: Marks and submission status
screens.notes: Cycle/list plus the teacher’s sheet is sufficient for subject status; full class review is class-lead only.

screens.title: Enter assessment scores
screens.notes: Save drafts, resolve make-up/absent-zero evidence, then submit. Teacher cannot edit submitted sheets without a return.

screens.title: Class report preparation
screens.notes: The class lead also submits their own subject sheet before reviewing the whole class; submit-review locks the package for principal review.

screens.title: Teaching reports
screens.notes: The catalogue exposes only teacher-permitted reports. PUBLISHED_BROADSHEET uses the current class-lead scope and latest accepted snapshots; SUBJECT_MARKS uses cycleId/assignmentId and the assigned-subject/class-lead scope. Working sheets are labelled; they do not become family reports. PDF/CSV downloads repeat authorization.

screens.title: Profile and responsibilities
screens.notes: School profile changes go through the office; personal login settings use SH07.

screens.title: Student home
screens.notes: Compose the home from own class/work/report/notification reads. The app chooses useful cards; Java supplies official data.

screens.title: My class and subjects
screens.notes: Class workspace and subject choices reflect dated placement. Families cannot change their own official class/department.

screens.title: Subject workspace
screens.notes: Class/subject material reads are scoped. Families see the accepted snapshot while the teacher edits the next draft; attachments require the same audience.

screens.title: Timetable and calendar
screens.notes: Use the daily projection for examination dates. Weekly view remains the recurring pattern; honour Africa/Lagos.

screens.title: Prepare and submit
screens.notes: Save a private draft, upload accepted files, then submit an immutable revision. Do not mark work submitted until the server accepts it.

screens.title: Submission and feedback
screens.notes: Use the authenticated own student ID. History and accepted feedback are server-owned; local drafts stay private.

screens.title: My results
screens.notes: Group the returned published reports by session/term from report details; the staff academic-session directory is not a family API.

screens.title: My term report
screens.notes: Use the report snapshot and PDF. Do not calculate official totals, grades or attendance percentages in TypeScript.

screens.title: My attendance
screens.notes: Show submitted attendance, missing-register coverage and official corrections for this selected pupil. Private teacher requests and office follow-up notes are not returned.

screens.title: Profile and academic history
screens.notes: Verified historical document copies use /documents and do not generate official marks. Only published permitted copies are returned. CSV imports use their specific preview/job/confirm routes.

screens.title: Parent home
screens.notes: Children are active PARENT contexts in /me/contexts. Set the selected school/role/child before requesting that child’s records.

screens.title: My children
screens.notes: Use contexts for child selection, including one global login across schools. Phone matching never merges accounts.

screens.title: Child overview
screens.notes: Verified historical document copies use /documents and do not generate official marks. Only published permitted copies are returned. CSV imports use their specific preview/job/confirm routes.

screens.title: Child timetable and calendar
screens.notes: Daily projection is child/department/choice-scoped. Do not pass another child’s class ID.

screens.title: Child learning
screens.notes: Class/subject material reads are scoped. Families see the accepted snapshot while the teacher edits the next draft; attachments require the same audience.

screens.title: Assignment and feedback
screens.notes: Read accepted versions/feedback only. Parents cannot submit or grade student work.

screens.title: Child attendance
screens.notes: Show submitted attendance, missing-register coverage and official corrections for this selected pupil. Private teacher requests and office follow-up notes are not returned.

screens.title: Child results
screens.notes: List published reports for the selected child and group by their snapshot session/term fields.

screens.title: Child report card
screens.notes: Download the server PDF for the exact report revision; old issued revisions remain readable.

screens.title: Child fees and payment history
screens.notes: Requires payer permission. Pass selected child ID where the endpoint accepts studentId.

screens.title: Invoice and payment
screens.notes: Open the returned Paystack hosted URL in the app browser. App does not collect card/bank credentials.

screens.title: Payment status and receipt
screens.notes: A browser return is not payment confirmation. Poll/verify the intent and use the confirmed receipt. The provider webhook is backend-only.

screens.title: Messages
screens.notes: Parent recipients are the current class lead or office. No public parent group or arbitrary teacher contact.

screens.title: Private conversation
screens.notes: Keep selected child/school in navigation and requests. Current participant checks also apply to attachments.

screens.title: My complaints
screens.notes: List only the selected parent’s permitted child-linked cases, not school-wide complaint records.

screens.title: Submit a complaint
screens.notes: Category determines permitted owner and scope. Upload private evidence only when its complaint resource can own it.

screens.title: Complaint and resolution
screens.notes: Resolve is a staff action; parent uses ACCEPT or REQUEST_REVIEW with the required reason. Private staff notes are never shown.

screens.title: Profile and relationships
screens.notes: School guardian contacts and global login contacts are separate records. Child/payer relationships are school-managed.

screens.title: Sign in
screens.notes: No public signup. School hands over login ID and one-time activation instructions; normal login can also use a verified email.

screens.title: Activate school account
screens.notes: Validate the school code/link, receive a short-lived flow token, set a private password and save the new personal recovery code.

screens.title: Create or change password
screens.notes: Activation/recovery uses proof setup. An authenticated password change needs the current password and signs out old sessions.

screens.title: Recover your account
screens.notes: Email requests return a generic response. Email/saved proofs are single-use; successful reset revokes old sessions and outstanding proofs.

screens.title: Choose school and role
screens.notes: List allowed server contexts; never invent role/child choices in the app. Context changes remain server-checked on subsequent requests.

screens.title: Notifications
screens.notes: Push tickets/receipts do not prove a person read the message. Only in-app read acknowledgement changes app-read state.

screens.title: Account settings
screens.notes: Use secure device token storage in the shared frontend. Sensitive recovery/email/session changes require recent authentication when the endpoint declares it.

screens.title: Verify email
screens.notes: An email address changes login/recovery ownership only after the link is accepted. Merely entering it does not verify it.

screens.title: Access help
screens.remaining: Assisted global-account recovery is intentionally unavailable until a verification policy is adopted. The agreed page is contact/help only; school staff cannot reset an active global identity.
